title: Orchard and Compass
author: T. M. Underhill
blurb: Marguerite Lockridge, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, has spent fifteen years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the century turns.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
